dimension_evidence.quote: TGA 8000 Width 18 in (45.8 cm); Depth 18 in (45.8 cm); Height 19 in (48.3 cm)
dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Chosen manufacturer site-readiness guide 012851_01, p1. Specification 012248_01 lists smaller H44/W43/D43cm; retained as revision/configuration conflict. Top travel and carousel pitch estimated from photos; reference represents instrument with autosampler.

author: Virtual Lab project
license: Project-authored geometry; manufacturer and facility reference material retain original copyright.
notes: Hang-down balance upper cylinder, vertical furnace below the balance, green 48-position sampler carousel, asymmetric rounded lower body and electronics block.
Furnace elevator, carousel rotation and transfer arm are separate demonstration joints. Temperature and mass-balance behavior are not simulated.
geometry_scope: Source-grounded visual reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD. All joint travel is numeric digital articulation, not measured hardware limits.

community_search.result: No verified licensed downloadable exact-model mesh found. A negative search is not proof that none exists.

protocol_validation_scope: Digital hierarchy, bounded joint movement, reset and ordered access workflow only; no vendor API, real sample handling, vacuum, pressure, laser, thermal or magnetic behavior validated.
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.reviewer: Primary agent visual QA after complete-file snapshot and asymmetric-support correction
review.scope: Actual pipeline render; supports under modeled asymmetric housing. Manufacturer envelope distinct from inferred supports, furnace and autosampler travel.

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked
